name: smwgraphics-the-legend-of-zelda-a-link-to-the-past-big-key
title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past - Big Key
description:
The Big Key from The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, repurposed to be used as a key from Super Mario World.

Includes two versions:
- A Link to the Past colors: Uses palette row F, a key disassembly is provided to be inserted with PIXI;
- Vanilla colors: uses palette row 8, can be inserted right away;

Pick the version you like more.
